subject: Consolidation Asklist: controls coverage + SLA baselines for compliance tooling
messages:
From: Olivia Kim <olivia@trustbridge.io>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + suggested consolidation asklist for Redwood

Hi Diego / Mina —

Thanks again for taking a quick intro yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short ‘asklist’ that tends to move procurement and engineering fast when customers are consolidating compliance tooling. I attached a one-pager SOC 2 snapshot and a short matrix of controls coverage. Highlights:

- Continuous evidence collection for cloud infra (AWS/GCP)
- Git-based repo scans and commit-level attestations
- Automation for user access reviews and SSO events
- Retention/export of audit logs for 12+ months
- Point-in-time evidence snapshots for audits

We can also share our SLA baseline and a 12-month roadmap if that helps in your vendor scoring.

Let me know if you want a 30–45 minute walkthrough with product + security engineers tomorrow.

Regards,
Olivia Kim
TrustBridge — Head of Customer Success
Attached: TrustBridge-SOC2-summary.pdf
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Olivia Kim <olivia@trustbridge.io>, sales@vanta.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + suggested consolidation asklist for Redwood

Thanks Olivia — helpful summary.

Marissa / Mina: we’re running a quick consolidation review to decide whether to go deeper with TrustBridge, Vanta, or Drata for primary evidence automation. Procurement wants a short, consistent asklist to send vendors so we can compare apples to apples. Ben, Rishi — I’m looping you for pricing/SOW perspective.

Key asks I want vendors to answer in their formal response (can be a short doc):
1) Current SOC 2 status and last audit report date; whether auditor contact is shareable.
2) List of continuous integrations (CI/CD, infra, SSO, HRIS) with sample artifact types.
3) SLA for data retention, evidence exports, and policy of historic artifact access.
4) Onboarding timeline (days to first evidence for infra + code + identities).
5) Pricing model for multi-team consolidation and any migration credits.

Also please attach a completed RFP-controls-matrix (I’ve attached a template) and any sample export.

Olivia — can TrustBridge provide the auditor name and a sample export for cloud logs by EOD Thu?

Diego
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: scoring rubric + timeline for vendor asklist

Team —

I built a quick rubric for evaluating vendor responses (columns on the sheet: Coverage, Automation level, Exportability, Onboarding effort, Pricing transparency, SLAs). I uploaded the template to the Drive folder in related_links. Please review and add your weights.

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 5/6: send asklist + RFP-controls-matrix to the three vendors
- Tue 5/11: collect responses and sample exports
- Fri 5/14: internal demo + scoring with security + infra
- Week of 5/17: shortlist & procurement commercial negotiation starts

Quick notes: Mina — prioritize infra export format (CloudTrail, VPC Flow, GKE audit logs) and whether the vendor can provide point-in-time snapshots for auditor review. Ben / Rishi — look at migration credits and whether we can get a 2–3 month waiver on overlapping fees.

Marissa
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: RFP-controls-matrix.xlsx
From: Alex Chen <alex@drata.io>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: olivia@trustbridge.io
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Drata: answers to asklist + feature matrix

Diego / Marissa —

Appreciate the opportunity. Please find attached a short feature matrix and answers to your five asks. Quick summary:

1) SOC 2: Type II issued 2027-02-15; auditor: BrightPath LLP (we can introduce).
2) Integrations: AWS CloudTrail, GCP Audit Logs, GitHub, Okta, and Workday; artifact types include config snapshots, IAM change logs, commit hashes, and Okta login reports.
3) SLA / Exports: 12 month retention by default, exports via S3 / BigQuery connectors; point-in-time snapshots available for audits (add-on).
4) Onboarding: 14–28 days to collect baseline infra evidence; 28–45 days for code + HR evidence depending on repo count.
5) Pricing: standard subscription + per-repo ingestion; we are prepared to offer a migration credit equivalent to one month with a 12-month commit.

Attachments: Drata-Feature-Matrix-2027.pdf

Happy to demo the audit export flow on Thu 5/6 at 10am PT if that timing works.

— Alex
Partnerships, Drata
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation Asklist: controls coverage + SLA baselines for compliance tooling

Team —

Quick recap after incoming vendor material: Drata has provided auditor details and a clear export path; TrustBridge sent a SOC snapshot but asked for our RFP matrix to complete. Vanta indicated they will respond with pricing and a migration credit proposal by Mon.

Next steps (action owners):
- Marissa: send the standardized asklist + RFP-controls-matrix to Vanta + TrustBridge (send by EOD Thu) — owner: marissa_cole.
- Mina: confirm required infra artifact schema for CloudTrail and Okta by Mon 5/10 — owner: mina_haddad.
- Ben / Rishi: draft negotiation ask (migration credit, staggered billing) and target terms we want for preferred vendor — owner: ben_carter, rishi_malhotra.
- Diego: schedule vendor demos week of 5/10 and consolidate scoring sheet.

If procurement can secure a 1–2 month migration credit and a 30–60 day rollback export window that preserves evidence snapshots we’ll move to shortlist.

Diego
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
